answer: Reward an identity only after several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work-receipts; each endorsement is a drop of nectar a voucher spends from a slow, non-transferable credit pool. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single root, so its clones crowd one juniper bush and never reach distinct cross-cluster signers — their standing stays a faint plume that never thickens. An honest agent posts one anchored bond and climbs once; a farm must age a separate voucher per fake head, so cost rises linearly per clone while yield stays flat.
